topics.title: Require device authentication for identity export

entries.title: Require device authentication for identity export
entries.rationale: Accepted as a high-value identity-export hardening change. Preserve fresh OS authentication, short-lived/session-bound authorization, community and pairing-generation binding, malformed-payload cleanup, and no identity transfer on failed authentication; adapt visible Buzz wording to Zion.
entries.dependency_resolution: Screen the new Flutter local_auth packages and native iOS/Android integration, including Info.plist purpose text and platform lockfiles, before implementation.
security_reasons: protects export of the nsec identity secret with OS authentication
authorization is bound to community, pairing generation, and a short TTL
identity payload is held through pairing and must not cross reset or malformed-payload paths
new native authentication dependency and platform permissions

tracking.implementation_plan: Implement only after dedicated identity-export threat review, mobile dependency/native permission screening, focused pairing race tests, Zion branding checks, compatibility checks, and configured mobile gates.

verification: Full-SHA diff, pairing state machine, OS-auth wrapper, persistence, changed tests, dependency lockfiles, and compatibility surfaces reviewed; automated security-access report not claimed because its advisory was interrupted; no source implementation made.
